lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - AUDITORIUM - DAY
lines.dialogue: I know. It’s kinda like sharing a stage with God, right? But you wanna know something? He chews with his mouth open. Spits little bits of salad right at you.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - AUDITORIUM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Hey. You’re here because you’re meant to be here.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - AUDITORIUM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Look, I remember my first day, it’s a lot to take in. But we’ll show you the ropes.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - DEEP’S ROOM - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: What the FUCK?

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - DEEP’S ROOM - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: You just walk in??

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - DEEP’S ROOM - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Turn around. Forget this ever happened.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - DEEP’S ROOM - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Who the HELL asked you??!!

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - DEEP’S ROOM - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Oh, you’re the fucking hero? Please. You’re here cause we needed a few more points with Evangelicals. There’s a dozen blonde cunts that fit the bill. You’re nobody. You breathe a word of this to anyone? You’re out. For good. The fuck back to Iowa. We clear? STARLIGHT Of course. I won’t tell anybody.

lines.scene: INT. THE SEVEN TOWER - BOARDROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: We were beginning to wonder if you’d even show up.
I’m allowed to visit my friends.
Sorry. No black box.

But -- I told my contacts to keep an eye on the North Atlantic Current. And this school of Halibut -- I mean, these dudes are rowdy motherfuckers -- Anyway, they found some of the wreckage that drifted up near Iceland. Found this.
I doubt it even works...
Flight 37. That was the one you and Homelander got to too late, right, it already went down? What do you care about it?
Yo! Here comes the A-Train!
Hey man! Hello? It’s me! Right here!
Oh, I came to see -- no reason. Bro. Been thinking about you. I’m sorry. Talk about getting assfucked with a soup can.
C’mon. If anyone knows what it’s like to get bounced, it’s me.
Did some shit I’m not proud of. Weird shit. A-TRAIN I’m fine. My people are talking to Nike and Under Armour. This’ll be good for me.
Hey, that’s great. Well, then you don’t need his help. Forget I said anything.
Would you like a Fresca?
Congrats, man.
She’s the sweetheart. ALASTAIR So what’s on your mind, A-Train?
I think A-Train has sabotaged me my entire career.
You think you’re better than me. I fantasize about drowning you, you know that? Over and over again. And I don’t want to have that feeling anymore. I wanna be clean.
Always happy to see you, sir.
Wait, that was you? Dude! I didn’t know, sir, fuck him, I would never go behind your back!
I’m back too, right? I’m anti-Nazi.
And they took him?
I don’t wanna pay for any more fucking courses!

I signed over my bank account to you! I filled out the workbooks, I married some weirdo who gives bad blowjobs, when I found out we’re all really just space spores, I didn’t laugh. I did everything you asked. Because you said you’d get me back in The Seven. You fucking promised.
Fuck Fresca.
I take responsibility. For racism.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: If we’re thinking about who’s got the most dirt on us, shouldn’t Ashley be, like, at the top?

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Awesome. I’ll just add her real quick -- does anybody know Ashley’s last name?
Sorry, bro.
Dude, you’re a writer, you don’t earn shit.
Tell me I’m the smartest Superhero in The Seven.
And you respect me the most. Besides Homelander, of course.
You’re only saying that cause you’re scared.
Yes, you are. But you know what, bro? Good enough for me.
Yo, have you seen Ashley?
No, bro, this is the other Ashley. She’s not even on the list.
Bro. Bro.
